topic.title: California asked 200 billionaires for 5% of their net worth. Voters look set to say no

shape.name: The exit door
shape.beats: hook: the easy-money belief denied -> the bill on paper, a sourced figure -> one example fortune's bill, computed -> the asker: so they just pay? -> where the money really is (shares, not cash) -> the turn: the people it was meant for simply leave first -> payoff: what happened to the bill, a question back to the viewer
shape.why: a tax, fee or rule aimed at the very rich whose surprise is that the rich can step out of its reach; fits wealth taxes, exit taxes, residency rules

cta: Tax them or let them go? Comment
title: California's billionaire tax had one escape hatch 🚪
description:
You think a one-time billionaire tax is easy money for California?
California's ballot measure, told with one illustrative fortune: the bill, where the money sits, and who had already left. No side taken on the vote.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
